name: KGL2BPMNPredicates
title: Knowledge graph L2BPMN: predicates
description: The predicates of the L2BPMN layer. An edge's `predicate` is one of these; which (source, target) pairs each licenses is the layer's edge table. Source: smart-base/L1/schemas/L2-BPMN.ts (migrated from smart-kg ontology/L2-BPMN/L2-BPMN.json).

concept.definition: A sequence flow, within one process. The qualifier carries the flow's name where it has one -- 6 of 70 in the lifecycle BPMN, all gateway branches such as "Yes - approved". No flow in that file carries a conditionExpression, so the label is the whole of the branch condition and nothing more is claimed. `openQualifier` says the value is free text authored in the diagram, not a term from a vocabulary, so an unseen label is not a finding.

A message flow, which by definition crosses participants. Kept distinct from flowsTo because a handoff between two roles is what governance and country adaptation look for, and burying 10 of them among 70 intra-process flows loses them.

A participant pool is performed by a persona. STRING EQUALITY between the pool's @name and an ActorDefinition's title, across two file formats with no shared identifier. Compare l2:fulfilledBy, where a requirement names a persona by Canonical() and resolves without guessing -- the mechanism exists; BPMN does not use it. Every instance carries a resolutionStatus.
